# Emails allowed to author or commit code pushed to this repository.

# Gates scripts/check_push_authors.py, the client-side pre-push guard: it
# refuses to push a branch carrying a commit whose author or committer email
# is not listed here. This exists to catch the same mistake as
# trust.sandboxTrustedAuthors (src/mergecraft/config/trust_policy.py,
# docs/trust-policy.md) — a fork PR checked out onto a local branch and
# pushed to origin — client-side, before the branch ever reaches origin.
#
# One email per line. Comparison is case-insensitive. Lines starting with
# `#` are comments. MERGECRAFT_TRUSTED_AUTHORS (comma-separated) overrides
# this file entirely when set.
